comment_pipeline: MAC pipeline shallowed MAC_LATENCY 8 -> 5 (mul_bf16_p3 -> mul_bf16_p2, add_fp32_p4 -> new add_fp32_p2). The depth-8 PE was sized for architecture.md's 300 MHz aspiration; at the M3 100 MHz target the depth-8 pre-DRT STA had setup WNS = 0 / fmax ~141 MHz (~2.9 ns slack), so the extra stages were spent down to cut routing cost. Per-PE flops 586 -> 344 (yosys 16x16: pe_pipelined 192 local + mul_bf16_p2 59 + add_fp32_p2 93); whole-design async-reset (dfrtp) flops ~147.3k -> ~91.5k, which also shrinks the post-CTS hold-buffer count (was 98.6k) and the design-repair buffers (was 104k in 15.9k nets). RUN_2026-06-03_14-17-05 was SLURM-killed at 20 h inside TritonRoute detailed routing (clean GR, 0 overflow); fewer flops/nets/buffers target that runtime wall. add_fp32_p2 is add_fp32_p4's logic regrouped onto 2 register boundaries (bit-exact; tb_top gemm + conv e2e both pass). DRT_SAVE_DRC_REPORT_ITERS = 1 added so the next detailed-routing run leaves a per-iteration DRC trail on disk (the prior kill left a 0-byte buffered log); pair with 'stdbuf -oL' on the openroad invocation. Fallback if 10 ns post-CTS STA fails: re-introduce a 3-stage adder (MAC_LATENCY 6).
comment_clock: 100 MHz (10.0 ns) target -- the M3 scope adjustment from architecture.md's 300 MHz aspiration (see synthesis_notes.md). The deeper MAC pipeline that was built chasing 300 MHz remains: m2/{pe,mul_bf16,acc_fp32::add_fp32} are replaced by m3/{pe_pipelined, mul_bf16_p3, add_fp32_p4} (MAC_LATENCY = 8 since Phase 11). Iteration log lives in synthesis_notes.md: depth bump (1) -> FSM-broadcast staging (2) -> disjunct-trick to defeat opt_merge (3) -> async-reset RTL (4) -> egress skid (5) -> fifo_sync split + ws registered read (6) -> mul_bf16_p2 to mul_bf16_p3 B-half radix-4 split (7). At 10 ns the prior post-resizer WNS (-1.13 ns at 300 MHz) closes with margin.
comment_floorplan: FP_CORE_UTIL = 55, PL_TARGET_DENSITY = 0.65 chosen after the depth-7 first attempt left u_core.state[1] (FSM bit driving all 16 PE clr_psum lines) on the critical path with most of the slack burned in 8+ buffer hops of wire delay rather than gate delay. Higher utilization shrinks the floorplan and the inter-PE wires that dominate that fanout. SYNTH_STRATEGY = 'DELAY 0' biases yosys toward shorter combinational chains at the cost of area.
comment_async_reset: All m3/rtl/*.sv always_ff blocks use 'posedge clk or posedge rst' so dfflibmap maps to sky130 dfrtp_2 / sdfrtp_2 (async-reset DFFs) instead of dfxtp_2 + a D-mux gated by rst. Removes the global rst signal from the data path; rst is now a clock-tree-style net that only has to satisfy recovery/removal w.r.t. clk, not setup. Sky130 has no synchronous-reset DFF cell - 'sdfrtp' is scan + async reset, so any sync-reset RTL collapses into combinational reset on plain dfxtp.
comment_array_shape: top.M = top.N = 16 (= 256 PEs) -- the M3 scope point (down from architecture.md's 48x48 aspiration; rationale in synthesis_notes.md). top.sv's parameter defaults are 16/16, so this OpenLane run and the co-sim share one size. FP_CORE_UTIL lowered for P&R headroom.
comment_streaming: M4 streaming: compute_core_pipelined gains a PIX_BLOCK parameter (top.sv default 32) and a runtime cfg_pix_count (the new PIX_COUNT AXI-Lite register at 0x14). One COMPUTE now streams up to PIX_BLOCK pixel columns through the resident weights, amortizing the M*N (256-cycle) weight reload + (M+N-1)*MAC_LATENCY pipeline fill over B pixels (measured ~27x fewer cycles vs B=1 on the RAFT Conv2d 5-1 schedule; effective AI 0.92 -> 8.2 FLOP/B, toward the 16.0 pin-BW ridge -- see ../bench/benchmark_data.csv). NO new module and NO SRAM macro: the storage is synthesizable registers, so VERILOG_FILES is unchanged. The cost is register area -- act_block (PIX_BLOCK*M*16b = 8192 flops at B=32) + result_buf (PIX_BLOCK*N*32b = 16384 flops) add ~24.5k flops on top of the ~91.5k M3 baseline (~+27%). The PE array, arithmetic units, FIFOs, and egress skid are bit-for-bit unchanged (they already route to DRT), so the new routing risk is localized to the B-deep result_buf read/write decoders and the act_block read mux in compute_core. If global routing congests there (the failure mode weight_store hit), the first levers, in order, are: (1) GRT_ADJUSTMENT down (frees routing capacity, the tool's own GRT-0704 hint); (2) FP_CORE_UTIL down from 45 (bigger die, lower local density -- watch it does not re-lengthen the clk/rst nets that earlier drove buffer counts); (3) drop top.sv PIX_BLOCK to 16 (~half the new flops, ~15x speedup) and re-elaborate. FP_CORE_UTIL is left at 45 (the value that produced clean GR + 0-overflow on the M3 RUN_2026-06-04) because LibreLane sizes the die from cell area at fixed utilization, so +27% cells grows the die at constant density rather than crowding it. The M3 synth/{timing,area,power}_report.txt are the pre-streaming baseline; refresh them from the streaming PnR run before quoting area/power in the report.
comment_acc_fp32_inclusion: m2/rtl/acc_fp32.sv is included only for its fp32_to_bf16 truncate module (used by compute_core_pipelined's drain serializer). The combinational add_fp32 in the same file is unused by the m3 datapath and should be DCE'd by yosys.
comment_congestion: Step-39 global routing bailed with [GRT-0116] in RUN_2026-05-31_23-55-33: residual overflow was tiny (total 4 GCells, all on met3/horizontal, Max H 2) against low global usage (27%), while the other horizontal layer met5 sat ~98% idle. Three knobs target this localized congestion: (1) GRT_ADJUSTMENT 0.30 -> 0.25 -- the tool's own GRT-0704 hint; frees routing capacity on every layer including met3. (2) GRT_LAYER_ADJUSTMENTS made explicit at the PDK default [li1,met1,met2,met3,met4,met5] = [0.99,0,0,0,0,0]; met3/met5 already carry zero reduction and the knob can only reduce capacity, so this is documentation-only -- the real horizontal lever is (1) (met5's idle/derate is PDN-strap driven, not this list). (3) FP_CORE_UTIL 35 -> 45 tightens the floorplan (~4935 -> ~4350 um/side) to shorten the long high-fanout clk/rst nets that drove ~43.9 mm wirelength and 102K repair buffers; PL_TARGET_DENSITY left at 0.55 (= the librelane auto default of FP_CORE_UTIL+10 at util 45). Attribution caveat: (1) frees routing while (3) raises local density -- they push opposite ways on met3, so for clean per-knob attribution (per synthesis_notes.md) run (1) alone first, then (3). Re-run on the synth host: librelane --last-run --from OpenROAD.GlobalRouting config.json.
